description: This power represents specific features, or elements in the world: weather, climates, unique places, special formations, complex geological elements, for example; geysers, craters, strong winds, currents, salt flats, landmarks, lava flows, natural resources, etc. Things that you would put on a map that aren't really represented with the other powers.
fantasticalDescription: This power represents fantastical features: magical weather patterns, portals, ley lines, etc.
